title: From article to quiz
caption: One whole agentic workflow turns any knowledge article, a PDF or a URL, into a quiz: each step in, on or out of the loop, a contract at every handoff.
goal: Goal: a quiz someone can use
workflowLabel: The agentic workflow, stage by stage

planRequirements.checkedBy: you name the epic to start

twoLevels: You design the path; the agent loops through its task; you steer at the checkpoints.

steps.process: Pick one recurring process. Mark each step: agent or person, in, on or out of the loop.
steps.contract: Write the contract first. What the task receives, what it delivers, how someone else checks it.
steps.conway: Suspect Conway’s law. If the workflow mirrors how people work today, redraw it around the goal.

workflow-and-agent-two-levels.description: Anthropic separates workflows, orchestrated through predefined code paths, from agents that direct their own process; reading the quiz example as a path you design and steer, with steps the agent runs in a loop, is an application of that split, not a claim the source makes [1].

one-whole-workflow.title: One whole workflow
one-whole-workflow.script: Let's put it all together in one whole agentic workflow. It takes any knowledge article, a PDF or a URL, and turns it into a quiz. The path of steps is yours to design, each step is a task the agent loops through, and you steer at the checkpoints, you, or later a harness.

in-on-or-out-per-step.title: In, on or out per step
in-on-or-out-per-step.script: Each step gets its own level, in, on or out of the loop, set by the risk of a wrong result and by how well that result can be checked. You can do this with a process of your own: pick one recurring process in your team and mark which steps an agent could run, and whether a person stays in, on or out for each.

a-contract-at-every-handoff.title: A contract at every handoff
a-contract-at-every-handoff.script: At every handoff sits a contract: what the next step receives, what it must deliver, and how someone else can check it. Write these three lines before you hand any task to an agent, and it is what lets you still trust what comes back.

designed-around-the-goal.title: Designed around the goal
designed-around-the-goal.script: Notice where this workflow started, from the goal, a quiz someone can use, and not from how any team works today. If you lead a transformation and the workflow your people draw mirrors how they work now, suspect Conway's law and redraw it around the goal. And look at your team, because breaking work down, writing clear handoffs and reviewing an agent's result are the skills to build. Pick one process, write the contracts, decide the levels, and build those three skills in your people.
